lead: Muttiah Muralitharan has built a public profile as a New Zealander cricketer, born on 17 April 1972 in Kandy.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has represented Sri Lanka national cricket team and Lancashire County Cricket Club and has been recognised with the Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
The sections that follow break down Muttiah Muralitharan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Muttiah Muralitharan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Muttiah Muralitharan was born on 17 April 1972 in Kandy, and holds New Zealander and Sri Lankan nationality.
He studied at St. Anthony's College, Kandy.

sections.heading: Muttiah Muralitharan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Muttiah Muralitharan works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, Muttiah has been associated with Sri Lanka national cricket team (from 1992 to 2010), Lancashire County Cricket Club (from 1999 to 1999), Lancashire County Cricket Club (from 2001 to 2001), Kent County Cricket Club (from 2003 to 2003), Chennai Super Kings (from 2008 to 2010), Kochi Tuskers Kerala (from 2011 to 2011), Gloucestershire County Cricket Club (from 2011 to 2012) and Wellington cricket team (from 2011 to 2011). He plays as a pitcher.
